# Security & Correctness Requirements Checklist: UCC Voice AI over Twilio + Pipecat

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements governing the authorization boundary, the voice
bridge, escalation, no-fabrication behaviour, log redaction and fail-fast configuration are
complete, unambiguous and measurable — before implementation hardens them into code.
**Created**: 2026-08-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope note**: This checklist asks whether the *requirements are well written*, not whether
the system works. Behavioural verification lives in [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md) V1–V9.

---

## Authorization Boundary Across an Out-of-Process Model

- [ ] CHK001 Are the requirements explicit that authorization is decided from persisted state rather than from any request content, for every protected tool without exception? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the set of "protected" tools defined somewhere requirements can be traced to, rather than left to the reader to infer from tool names? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what the voice pipeline may and may not do with a tool result, in terms specific enough to be reviewable (relay verbatim, no caching, no substitution)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified that the case id used in a tool call comes from the bound session and never from model-supplied arguments? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, Data Model §4]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements stated for the case where the model requests a tool that is not in the fetched catalogue? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Is there a requirement covering failure to fetch the tool catalogue at session start — proceed with no tools, refuse the session, or escalate? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the requirements consistent between the spec and the contract on whether an authorization denial is an error or a normal result? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Contract voice-bridge-api]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "the security boundary does not move with the model" expressed as a testable requirement rather than only as a principle? [Measurability, Constitution §X]

## Voice Bridge Authentication & Per-Call Binding

- [ ] CHK009 Are both credentials (service credential and per-call token) required on every protected request, with the requirement stating that either alone is insufficient? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the per-call token's lifetime quantified, or is "short-lived" left as an unmeasurable adjective? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for a token that expires *during* a long call — is the call dropped, the token refreshed, or the tool call refused? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the distinction between `401` and `403` specified consistently for missing credential versus wrong-case binding? [Consistency, Contract voice-bridge-api]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements stated for token reuse across two concurrent sessions claiming the same case? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the requirement that `GET /api/ai/tools` needs only the service credential stated in the spec, or only in the contract? [Consistency, Contract voice-bridge-api]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the threat that the token transits Twilio documented as an accepted risk with its blast radius bounded in writing? [Assumption, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for what the caller experiences when the bridge rejects a tool call for an authentication reason, as distinct from a business denial? [Gap, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the scope boundary explicit that this closes only the voice bridge and not the wider missing end-user authentication? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Session Binding & Refusal

- [ ] CHK018 Are the conditions for refusing a session enumerated completely (missing case id, missing token, unknown case)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Contract stream-parameters]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it specified what the *caller* hears when a session is refused, or does the requirement only describe closing the socket? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined stating that bound session values are immutable for the session's lifetime? [Clarity, Data Model §1]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the requirement to refuse rather than degrade stated as mandatory, with no permitted fallback to an ungoverned conversation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Escalation Reaching a Human

- [ ] CHK022 Is "the caller reaches a human" defined as an acceptance condition distinct from the case reaching an escalated state? [Measurability, Spec §US3, §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the ordering requirement explicit that the assistant stops speaking *before* the transfer proceeds, rather than merely at some point during it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the 30-second target in SC-008 anchored to a defined start event (caller asks, tool returns, session closes)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for which component ends the call on escalation, so that neither both nor neither does? [Consistency, Contract stream-parameters, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements stated for a caller asking for a human while a tool call is already in flight? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the no-agent-available and transfer-failed paths specified as distinct requirements with distinct caller-facing outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK028 Is there a requirement that the agent receives conversation context from the voice leg, and is the required content of that context specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for capturing the voice leg into the existing transcript, so an escalated case is not missing its AI segment? [Gap]

## No-Fabrication Behaviour

- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements distinguishing "retrieval returned nothing" from "retrieval failed" and specifying different caller-facing outcomes for each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the requirement that a refusal states the *real* remediation assigned to a specific owner — the tool's message, the prompt, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements stated preventing the model from inventing an alternative identity-verification procedure, given this has been observed in a prior spike? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §US2 scenario 6]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the prohibition on empty tool results specified as a requirement rather than as contract guidance only? [Consistency, Contract voice-bridge-api, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK034 Can "contains no invented specifics" be objectively evaluated, or does the requirement need a defined evaluation method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements defined for the assistant repeating back a value the caller supplied, so it is not later treated as confirmed? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Log Redaction & Observability

- [ ] CHK036 Is "unnecessary personal data" defined by enumeration rather than left to implementer judgement? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK037 Are redaction requirements stated for *both* services, given the voice service uses a different logging stack from the UCC API? [Coverage, Data Model §Redaction]
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements defined for passcodes appearing inside a transcript fragment, as distinct from a passcode field? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK039 Is there a requirement that latency metrics are reported without implying stages exist in the speech-to-speech mode that do not? [Clarity, Data Model §5]
- [ ] CHK040 Are the per-stage latency requirements traceable to the success criteria that consume them? [Traceability, Spec §FR-034, §SC-002..§SC-005]
- [ ] CHK041 Is the correlation-id requirement stated as applying to every log line, including errors raised before the session is bound? [Coverage, Spec §FR-033]

## Fail-Fast Configuration

- [ ] CHK042 Are the conditions that must prevent startup enumerated completely (missing credential, unknown provider, unavailable model, invalid mode)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the prohibition on silent fallback stated for *every* configuration key, or only for the pipeline mode? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK044 Are requirements defined for detecting a mismatched service credential between the two services at startup rather than on the first tool call? [Gap, Quickstart §Configuration]
- [ ] CHK045 Is the Python version floor stated as a requirement, given a dependency enforces it? [Traceability, Research §R2]
- [ ] CHK046 Are timeout values quantified, or is "bounded timeout" left unmeasurable? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-039]

## Topology Equivalence — Shared, Not Merely Similar

- [ ] CHK047 Is "same transport, serializer, tool bridge and gate" expressed in a way that can be objectively confirmed, rather than asserted? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK048 Are requirements defined ensuring both topologies use identical prompt text, so a latency comparison is not confounded by prompt differences? [Gap, Research §R4, Plan §Key design decisions]
- [ ] CHK049 Is the requirement that switching topology needs exactly one configuration change stated precisely enough to fail if a second change is needed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK050 Are requirements stated for the known asymmetry in how each topology receives its system prompt, so it is handled rather than discovered? [Completeness, Research §R4]
- [ ] CHK051 Is the measurement method for the topology comparison specified before results exist, including sample size and what would invalidate it? [Measurability, Spec §US4 scenario 4, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK052 Are requirements defined for reporting a topology that fails its latency target, rather than only for the success case? [Gap, Spec §SC-003]

## Verification of the Work Itself

- [ ] CHK053 Is "executed and verified" distinguished from "implemented" by a stated definition, given this distinction is now a constitutional requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-045, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK054 Are the minimum test subjects enumerated specifically enough that a missing one is detectable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK055 Is the requirement for real-phone-call validation scoped to which scenarios must be dialled versus which may be automated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-044]

## Ambiguities, Conflicts & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK056 Is the assumption that the existing gate, verification and knowledge services are correct recorded with a stated consequence if it proves false? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK057 Are requirements defined for DTMF entry of the passcode, given callers commonly key digits rather than speak them? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK058 Is the exclusion of concurrent-call and mid-call-restart requirements stated deliberately rather than by omission? [Gap, Plan §Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK059 Do the requirements conflict anywhere between "refuse to start on bad config" and "degrade safely on failure", and is the boundary between startup and runtime explicit? [Conflict, Spec §FR-026, §FR-041]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference

**Reviewer guidance — the highest-value items in this list.** CHK006, CHK011, CHK019, CHK029, CHK044 and CHK057 each identify a scenario the requirements currently do not address at all, rather than one they address imprecisely. CHK022 and CHK024 target the exact ambiguity that let a previous live call be reported as a success while the caller heard nothing. Treat those eight as the gating subset if time is short.
